messages.subject: Error messages with shiny dashboard
parts:
Hi,

Normally we can prevent error messages taking the place of some output or other UI element by making sure to validate() common input problems. But I was wondering what if I want to send the errors to one of the dropdown menus as a notification item introduced in shiny dashboard? Can this perhaps be done by catching errors with try catch, sending them to a data structure which then triggers an update of the notification items in the dropdown?

Thanks,
Ben.
